lead: Mad Monkey Media makes reels, brand films and ads for showrooms, brands and creators, so more people notice you, trust you and get in touch.
statement: We are a video studio that turns *ordinary* businesses into brands people *remember.* One team plans, shoots, edits and runs your ads, so you get more views, more trust and more enquiries.

services.lead: From the first idea to the final file, one team handles planning, shooting, editing and ads. Pick one service or combine a few.

grade.text: Raw footage looks flat. Colour grading gives it mood, natural skin tones and a soft, film-like finish. Drag the line to see the difference.
bullets: One consistent look across all your videos
Clean sound with no dead air

process.lead: Simple, clear and quick. You always know what happens next.

steps.title: Share your idea
steps.text: Tell us about your business, your goal and who you want to reach. A WhatsApp message is enough to begin.

steps.title: We plan and shoot
steps.text: We write the hook and script, plan every shot and film at your location or in our setup with proper lighting.

steps.title: You review
steps.text: You get the first cut in 24-48 hours. Ask for changes as many times as you need. Revisions are unlimited.

steps.title: Post and grow
steps.text: We send final files in the right sizes. Post them as reels, run them as ads, or both.

bad: Quality changes from video to video
good: A full team on your project
The same premium look, every time

features.title: Quick turnaround
features.text: You do not wait weeks. Your first cut reaches you in 24-48 hours.

features.title: A real team
features.text: Senior editors, camera crew and a person you can always reach.

features.title: Detail in every frame
features.text: We check colour, sound and pacing on every video before it reaches you.
